blockers.description: Exact documentation source and asset bodies and per-page content hashes are not retained.
Manual/Python documentation builds and generated references have not been reproduced.
Module, Basic, Pro, ovitos, installers, entitlement, activation, and native behavior remain separate.

ovito-exact-document-tree-inventory.title: OVITO v3.15.5 complete documentation-tree metadata inventory

limitations: The exact doc-tree inventory does not establish body coverage, generated-reference closure, edition/entitlement identity, package artifact identity, native execution, modifier numerical validation, rendering determinism, or scientific acceptance.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path/object metadata are retained; documentation source bodies and images remain external.

documentation-build-not-replayed.description: Manual and Python documentation builds and generated API/reference pages have not been reproduced from the exact tag.

edition-and-pro-entitlement-external.description: Basic desktop, Pro desktop/ovitos, standalone module, entitlement, activation, installer, and native behavior remain separate external surfaces.

third-party-and-artifact-provenance-clos.description: Third-party notices, distribution artifacts, Pro binaries, user trajectories, and generated artifacts require separate identity and provenance closure.

analysis.atomic-strain.statement: Atomic strain depends on reference mapping, cutoff/neighbors, cell deformation, least-squares conditioning, and output tensor conventions.
analysis.atomic-strain.title: Atomic strain depends on reference mapping, cutoff/neighbors, cell deformation, least-squares conditioning, and output tensor conventions.

analysis.common-neighbor.statement: Common-neighbor analysis has version-bound mode, cutoff/adaptive behavior, structure labels, and validation limits.
analysis.common-neighbor.title: Common-neighbor analysis has version-bound mode, cutoff/adaptive behavior, structure labels, and validation limits.

analysis.coordination-rdf.statement: Coordination analysis and radial distribution functions require cutoff, pair/selection, PBC, normalization, binning, units, frame, and convergence evidence.
analysis.coordination-rdf.title: Coordination analysis and radial distribution functions require cutoff, pair/selection, PBC, normalization, binning, units, frame, and convergence evidence.

analysis.dislocation-extraction.statement: Dislocation extraction analysis has crystal structure, circuit, line, Burgers-vector, smoothing, edition, and validation requirements.
analysis.dislocation-extraction.title: Dislocation extraction analysis has crystal structure, circuit, line, Burgers-vector, smoothing, edition, and validation requirements.

analysis.displacement-vectors.statement: Displacement vectors depend on reference configuration, cell deformation, mapping, PBC, affinity, and frame identity.
analysis.displacement-vectors.title: Displacement vectors depend on reference configuration, cell deformation, mapping, PBC, affinity, and frame identity.

analysis.polyhedral-template-matching.statement: Polyhedral template matching has template, RMSD, orientation, deformation, selection, and validation semantics.
analysis.polyhedral-template-matching.title: Polyhedral template matching has template, RMSD, orientation, deformation, selection, and validation semantics.

analysis.time-averaging.statement: Trajectory averaging requires explicit frame range, transient handling, property continuity, time weights, and uncertainty interpretation.
analysis.time-averaging.title: Trajectory averaging requires explicit frame range, transient handling, property continuity, time weights, and uncertainty interpretation.

analysis.wigner-seitz.statement: Wigner-Seitz defect analysis requires a validated reference lattice, mapping, occupancy interpretation, PBC, and cell compatibility.
analysis.wigner-seitz.title: Wigner-Seitz defect analysis requires a validated reference lattice, mapping, occupancy interpretation, PBC, and cell compatibility.

api.data-collection-cell.statement: DataCollection, SimulationCell, particle properties, cell-vector column conventions, and frame metadata are version-bound API surfaces.
api.data-collection-cell.title: DataCollection, SimulationCell, particle properties, cell-vector column conventions, and frame metadata are version-bound API surfaces.

api.export-file.title: ovito.io.export_file has frame, format, column, precision, identifier, and output-reparse semantics that must be explicit.

api.file-source-load.statement: FileSource.load replaces a pipeline source and must be recorded as an input-identity change.
api.file-source-load.title: FileSource.load replaces a pipeline source and must be recorded as an input-identity change.

api.pipeline-compute.statement: Pipeline.compute(frame) evaluates a zero-based frame and returns an independent DataCollection snapshot.
api.pipeline-compute.title: Pipeline.compute(frame) evaluates a zero-based frame and returns an independent DataCollection snapshot.

export.tables-trajectories.title: Export requires explicit object, format, frames, columns, precision, mapping, units, overwrite policy, and output reparse.
